card.name: Degree words before heart block
card.fires_on: The word just before a heart block term that states its degree, mainly "complete" before atrioventricular or AV block. It also fires on "than" in "greater than first degree" and on a number such as "3" in "3rd degree".

modes.label: complete before block
modes.description: The word "complete" sits right before atrioventricular or AV block in lists of conduction side effects.
modes.example: Patients treated with arsenic trioxide can develop QTc prolongation, torsade de pointes, and<< complete>> atrioventricular block.

modes.label: greater than first degree
modes.description: The word "than" follows "heart block greater" in contraindication lists.
modes.example: Metoprolol tartrate tablets are contraindicated in sinus bradycardia, heart block greater<< than>> first degree

modes.label: numbered degree
modes.description: A number stands for the degree of AV block.
modes.example: another patient (0.032 mg/kg) developed AV block—<<3>>rd degree and nonsustained polymorphic
